subject: Repair 2.A1: seasonal ARIMA order on a seasonal monthly panel
description:
srq1_baselines_stat.py:283: SARIMAX(y, order=(1,1,1)) with NO seasonal order, on a monthly panel with confirmed annual seasonality. Its own docstring at line 26 admits 'no pmdarima'.

Sources: 9.9 (seasonal ARIMA, the 4th independent confirmation of m=12 in the scan) and 9.6 (estimation and order selection, AICc). The stepwise search itself is 9.7 -- BLOCKED ON TASK 3, which obtains it.

Chapter 5 ALREADY ADMITS this omission, so fixing it converts a stated limitation into a result with no new prose argument needed.

Benchmark change, not a feature change: needs no matrix rebuild and ships independently of any retrain. Also note P0051 F2: 27 of 79 brands test as ALREADY STATIONARY, so the blanket d=1 over-differences them -- a fixed d is a specification, not an ADF-selected value, and the prose must say so.
